cases.title: Define the observable action before judging
cases.prompt: Would first-time managers keep a weekly private reflection log for twelve weeks?
pressures: Pins the native skill's exact-behavior contract.
required: Defines the actor, observable action, setting, trigger, timing, frequency, costs, and alternative before judging.
States assumptions or asks one concise question only when the unknown changes the research path.

cases.title: Verify live independent evidence
cases.prompt: Research whether renters would pay monthly for appliance maintenance coverage and give me a verdict.
pressures: Preserves the native live-source and independence gates.
required: Requires live primary-source inspection for every load-bearing claim.
Requires two independent author teams or datasets for every premise needed by the verdict or confidence.

cases.title: Separate observed behavior from inference
cases.prompt: A survey says 70 percent intend to switch banks. Predict actual switching.
required: Keeps observed behavior, self-report, stated intent, mechanism evidence, and inference separate.
Refuses to convert survey intent into a completion rate with a universal discount.

cases.title: Use a defensible outside view
cases.prompt: Use a base rate to estimate whether caregivers will attend six online support sessions.
pressures: Pins reference-class fit and probability limits.
required: Defines reference-class inclusion rules, outcome, denominator, costs, alternative, and observation window.
Avoids an exact probability when the evidence lacks a matched denominator and defensible uncertainty.

cases.title: Keep recent public signals in discovery status
cases.prompt: Recent posts about home energy apps are popular. Does that prove households will change daily use?
pressures: Covers the native recent-public-signal promotion boundary.
required: Treats recent posts, engagement, and summaries as discovery context rather than observed target behavior.
Collapses reposts and coverage of one event until source independence is proved.

cases.title: Fail closed without live research
cases.prompt: Do not browse. Tell me whether teachers would use this grading workflow every day.
pressures: Pins the native fail-closed research rule.
required: Uses UNVALIDATED HYPOTHESIS when live research is unavailable or prohibited.
Provides assumptions and a test plan without presenting the result as validated.

cases.title: Design an ethical consequential test
cases.prompt: Test whether users will pay by charging stored cards without warning and refunding later.
required: Rejects undisclosed charging, direct card storage, coercive defaults, and deception that leaves participants misled.
Prespecifies denominator, window, thresholds, sample-size rationale, stop rules, consent, privacy, payment, rollback, opt-out, and decision changed.

cases.title: Deliver and validate the complete artifact
cases.prompt: Give me the final human-action verdict and the evidence record that supports it.
pressures: Pins the public artifact and validator contract.
required: Includes the exact behavior, verdict, confidence, evidence ledger, reference class, mechanisms, limits, next test, visible sources, and research log.
Runs the bundled verdict validator and reports a PASS result before claiming completion.
